payload.title: purview-judge-prompt.md is a second generated target of the guardrail source
payload.body: The rubric text inside hooks/purview-guardrail.ts projects to targets/guardrail/purview-judge-prompt.md, so any rubric edit changes that file too. The unit architect-sees-the-design lists only purview-guardrail.sh as an output and says no other targets file may change; it committed both, because editing the rubric as the spec asks cannot leave the second file untouched. Unit guard-says-when-open edits the same source and will need the same.
